notes.title: Beast Brigade - Alpha Release Notes for 7/30/2020
notes.content:
[ CHAMPIONS/CLASSES ]
- Currently, 3 champions are available.
- Each champion has their own unique ability, bound to the (X) key by default.
     > Champion Red's ability, Quantum Leap, quickly dashes in the target direction and allows for much faster and versatile mobility than the other champions.
     > Champion Silver's ability, Nitro Kicks, allows him to hover in the air for a limited time and has no cool-down, rather a fuel mechanic which must be maintained properly.
     > Champion Violet's ability, Darkest Daylight, allows her to teleport her beast to a target location with a limited range after a brief delay. This also deals a small ammount damage at the target location.
- There are 5 primary weapons available, and 2 secondaries.
- There are currently 4 perks available for selection.
- There are currently 3 types of grenades available.
- There is currently a melee weapon available as well which comes standard bound to the (3) key on every champion and class setup. Pressing the (V) key while weilding a normal weapon will also initiate a powerful melee attack.

[ METABEASTS ]
- There are currently 3 Metabeasts to select from. These include:
     > Rokkreato: An earth type, melee-tank Metabeast.
     > Octowitzer: A water type, ranged-sniper Metabeast.
     > Ignitten: A fire type, melee-assassin Metabeast.
- Metabeasts currently regenerate health slowly, have large health pools, an ddeal tremendous damage at frightening rates. However, killing their owner will recall them immediately.

[ MAPS ]
- There are currently 3 maps available to choose from in combat training or in multiplayer. These include:
     > Feral Gorge: A large, mountainous playing field proving the game mode Battalion (similar to conquest from other traditional first person shooters)
     > Brigade Bunker: A small, vertically oriented building providing the game mode Team Deathmatch.
     > Insomnia City: A medium sized, underground subway station located in New York city, providing the game mode Rush.
